Players Committee card image of [[Baniss Keeg, Pilot Instructor]] (original printing), game text: “Adds 3 to power and 1 to hyperspeed of anything she pilots. Once per turn, if you just deployed a Black Sun agent to same system, may draw top card of Reserve Deck. Your characters here are immune to Cantina Brawl and Fallen Portal.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual3-Dark/large/banisskeegpilotinstructor.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
